data.response:
I’d pick **Rossi Idraulica**, subject to confirming the ten year warranty.

| | Rossi | TermoCasa |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Including VAT | €3,950 | €4,148 |
| Quoted warranty | 10 years, yearly servicing required | 5 years |
| Quoted timing | Two weeks | Next week |

Rossi saves **€198**, includes old boiler removal, and already services your boiler. TermoCasa’s advantage is earlier installation; removal isn’t specified.

The quotes are undated, so timing needs reconfirming. Rossi’s ten year cover also needs written confirmation: [Vaillant’s published programme](https://www.vaillant.it/servizi/garanzia/estensione-garanzia-7-caldaie/) describes seven years.
